name: wemind-monorepo
description: WeMind — your AI mind, reachable on WeChat. Monorepo: reusable iLink protocol core, a publishable MCP server, and a publishable always-on daemon CLI (wemind).
$comment: 根包刻意不叫 wemind：发布包 wemind 由 packages/wechat-daemon 提供。npm workspaces 里同名包会让「根包」与「工作区包」撞名，导致 -w wemind 解析到根包（private 且无 bin）。

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run build -w wemind -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run typecheck -w wemind -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
scripts.verify:publish: npm run check:version && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run -w wemind -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
